After that we took a crazy lady outside. I went to the Landlord to tell him about some chick destroying stuff in his building. 
He kicked her a few times and called the police to take her out. Turns out she was a suspect of many investigations and will stay in jail for a long time. 
What a night that was! I need to calm down for now and I’m tired of all of this.\nI’m just happy that I’m alive and my sexbot is in one piece. \n
